newsitem.title: USA: General Growth to buy two shopping malls.
newsitem.headline: General Growth to buy two shopping malls.

text.p: General Growth Properties Inc said Tuesday it agreed to acquire The Oaks Mall in Gainesville, Fla. and Westroads Mall in Omaha, Neb. from Prudential Insurance Co of America.
The proposed transactions require approval by the boards of both companies.
Details of the transactions were not disclosed but General Growth said the acquisitions will immediately add to earnings.
In a related development, General Growth said it is evaluating a proposal from a potential institutional co-investor to purchase about half of both malls.

The Oaks Mall is a five-anchor, one-level, dominant, fashion-oriented regional mall. It contains 907,392 square feet and generates $185 million of sales annually. The mall is 96 percent occupied and has sales of about $303 per square foot.

Westroads Mall is a four-anchor, two-level, regional mall. At 1.1 million square feet, it is the largest mall in Nebraska with sales of over $175 million annually. The mall is 95 percent occupied and has sales of about $297 per square foot.
General Growth owns, develops and manages shopping malls.
